text:
maya: FYI saw a spike of 502s during eu-west staggered promote when a subset of pods hit PV attach timeout. Deploy-bot tripped and scheduled rollback.
deploy-bot: Automated action: promotion paused. Will rollback in 5m unless manual pin annotated. Reason: pod error spike during eviction/attach.
maya: Looks infra-related (attach queue + node drain overlap), not an app regression. Can we hotpatch the routing instead of full rollback?
rob-sre: Hotpatching traffic split is fine, but deploy-bot will still rollback unless we pin the HelmRelease. Suggest pin+route fallback for safety.
tina: I'm +1 for a short pin. Add approver in annotation and a clear rollforward plan.
ops-eng: Command to pin: `kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-auth-v1 release.redwood/pinned-by=maya release.redwood/pin-reason="pv-attach-drain" --overwrite` then `deployctl rollout patch srvc-auth-v1 --suppress-auto-rollback=true`.
maya: Applying annotation now. Adding release-note snippet: "temp pin: pv-attach delay during node drain in eu-west, monitoring; rolling back if persists >30m"
deploy-bot: Pin detected. Automated rollback suppressed (TTL 45m). Manual unpin: `kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-auth-v1 release.redwood/pinned-by-`.
rob-sre: I'll watch error budgets and attach queue metrics. If healthy at +20m we unpin and finish promote. If not, rollback at +30m.
tina: I'll update release notes and send a short blurb to #product-notifications about the temporary pin.
maya: INFRA ticket INFRA-2180 created to requeue PV attach and review attach controller logs.
ops-eng: Added a temporary traffic-split to divert 30% away from canary while we wait for attaches to settle.
rob-sre: Metrics trending down after requeue. Plan stands: unpin at +22m if stable.
maya: Removing pin early at 22m after checks. Promotion resumed and finished. Closing thread."
